mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 18 degrees now, few clouds. Next 24 hours: high 17, low 9.

Albanian market inspectors have issued 26 fines totalling 98,000 euros for the sale of weak ready-mix concrete, cement and concrete elements after 54 spot checks.

Real Madrid has officially extended Belgian goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois's contract, keeping him at the club until 2028.

The Serbian student organization Lista Studentore says it will review the legality of the Brussels-brokered agreements with Kosovo, while the EU stresses that Serbia must fully implement them.

Strong winds swept Tetovo, sparking two separate fires and prompting 15 fire-fighter interventions overnight.

Albanian police arrested a 25-year-old in Tirana accused of fraud after he pretended to be a public official and demanded one million euros from a 54-year-old victim.
